NFL 2026 results and highlights: Pittsburgh Steelers suffer shock loss to Philadelphia Eagles as Dallas Cowboys score 51 in win
All results from Week 11 of the 2026 NFL season as the Philadelphia Eagles ended a seven-game losing streak by stunning the playoff-chasing Pittsburgh Steelers, while the Dallas Cowboys' offense was on fire as they put up 51 points in a big win over the Tennessee Titans
Sunday 22 November 2026 22:22, UK
